title: Constants and Enums Generator
description: Generate TypeScript constants, enums, and configuration values in src/lib/constants/ with TypeScript support and export configuration.

name.description: Name of the constants file (e.g., userRoles, endpoints, statusCodes). Uses UPPER_SNAKE_CASE naming conventions.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for this constants file?

package.description: Subdirectory within src/ where constants are created (default: 'lib' creates src/lib/constants/)

projectName.description: Target project name where constants will be generated. Auto-creates feature if not found.

directory.description: Override the entire directory path for constants creation

file.description: Optional: Create or append constants to existing file instead of creating separate file

skipFormat.description: Skip prettier code formatting (used internally for chained generators)
